gates.defect: The 50,000 metre radius is passed to a conversion expecting kilometres, so the Lucene radius is about 1,000 times too large.
gates.requiredProof: The 49.9 km point is included, the 50.1 km point is excluded, and both engines return identical logical IDs; BKD versus geohash remains directional.

gates.defect: Lucene writes a price point but reads absent NumericDocValues and only inspects the first leaf, allowing a no-op or partial aggregation.
gates.requiredProof: Two segments produce non-zero count, sum, sum-of-squares, min, max, mean and variance matching an independent calculation.

gates.defect: Lucene extracts terms and creates a query per invocation while LeanCorpus reuses terms extracted and cached on first access.
gates.requiredProof: Selected terms and candidate IDs match, cache state is explicit, and timed extraction plus search boundaries are equivalent.

gates.defect: The Lucene price field has no DocValues and its score provider applies one multiplication rule instead of the four LeanCorpus score modes.
gates.requiredProof: Populated price DocValues affect scores for Multiply, Replace, Sum and Max, with matching logical top-K results and defined missing or non-positive behaviour.

gates.defect: The shared Lucene index uses default classic TF-IDF while LeanCorpus uses BM25, so ranked results use mismatched index-time and query-time similarity.
gates.requiredProof: A matched BM25 profile sets the writer and searcher models explicitly and returns the same logical hits; defaults-as-shipped use a separate comparison ID.

gates.defect: The Lucene case sorts input in memory before indexing, reassigns document IDs and uses RAMDirectory, which is not native index sorting or the same persistence boundary.
gates.requiredProof: Preserve original external IDs and prices, validate the exact document set and sorted order, and label the pre-sorted workload Directional with no competitive ratio.

gates.defect: Lucene collapse considers only TopN times ten candidates and facet pagination requests preceding buckets without extracting the requested offset page.
gates.requiredProof: A group first present after candidate 250 is retained, representatives and totals match, and offset two with page size two returns C and D without duplicates.

gates.defect: One shared Lucene index is queried with BM25, TF-IDF and language models despite norms being created by its original index-time similarity.
gates.requiredProof: Each incompatible model has a suitable writer fixture; effective writer and searcher models, norms, score vectors and ranking are validated.

gates.defect: Approximate vector results are rejected only at zero recall, and the quantisation case checks result count rather than neighbour relevance.
gates.requiredProof: Compare deterministic approximate results with exact cosine ground truth at K=1, 10 and 100, record score and rank error plus quantisation score error, and enforce the fixture-pinned 0.9 recall floor; one of ten must fail.

gates.defect: Unlimited, truncated and rejected token-budget variants index different accepted documents and token counts from the same source dataset.
gates.requiredProof: Run the pinned fixture through Core indexing and verify accepted document and indexed-token counts for Unlimited, Truncate and Reject; record accepted/rejected documents and indexed tokens for each DataForge mode; allow baseline ratios only for Unlimited and budget variants with identical accepted documents and indexed tokens, while keeping fixed-budget truncation and rejection in a no-baseline class.

gates.defect: The compatibility case parses 65,537 characters successfully while the comparison case rejects at the 16,384-character guard before parsing.
gates.requiredProof: Validate equivalent AST output for valid parses and the exact limit and limit-plus-one rejection; treat parse and defensive rejection as separate operations.

gates.defect: The bytes-per-point row times a FileInfo metadata lookup, and the ColdOpen label creates a new reader without proving cold OS page-cache state.
gates.requiredProof: Calculate bytes per point after the completed build, keep metadata lookup outside timed methods, and label reader-instance warmth truthfully.

gates.defect: LeanCorpus disables durable commits while Lucene uses commit defaults and different directory semantics.
gates.requiredProof: Define matched and as-shipped persistence profiles, then verify committed contents, restart readability and durability boundaries; mismatched defaults remain Directional.

gates.defect: The result grouping omits job and runtime identity and chooses the lowest mean among duplicate rows.
gates.requiredProof: Keep distinct job/runtime/parameter identities and trace versus final rows; preserve conflicting valid finals or apply a declared aggregation, never select the minimum.

gates.defect: The benchmark returns a candidate count without checking whether suggestions contain a known correction or rank it usefully.
gates.requiredProof: Use fixed correction ground truth and report accuracy@1, recall@5, MRR and coverage, including an intentional no-suggestion case; mismatched quality remains Directional.
